title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Final Demurrage Invoice Line
content:
## Purpose

A Demurrage and Detention Free Time record whose last clock has stopped is invoiced for its demurrage on a final demurrage line. The line records how many demurrage days went beyond free time, the first and last of those days, and what they cost. If none of the record's demurrage days lies past its free time, the record receives no demurrage line.

## The booking action

The line is booked with `book_demurrage_invoice_a2ad21e7`, a desk tool held back from the everyday tool set. The agent must unlock it before it can be called, and the agent makes the call itself.

### Effect of a booking

A fresh demurrage invoice entry, dated the day the booking is made, is created on the record with the demurrage days billed, the first and last demurrage day it covers and its amount. The balance the billed party owes on the record goes up by that amount, and the record's status becomes invoiced. On an import record the entry is import demurrage; on an export record it is export demurrage. The customer can afterwards see the new line and the higher balance.

### Inputs

- `dnd_id` — the free-time record's reference number, as it appears in the free-time record lookup.
- `chargeable_days` — the number of billed demurrage days lying past free time; an integer count of calendar days.
- `period_start_date` — the first demurrage day on the line, in the form YYYY-MM-DD.
- `period_end_date` — the last demurrage day on the line, in the form YYYY-MM-DD.
- `amount_usd` — the line's demurrage amount in US dollars: a positive value with two decimals, rounded to the cent before it is supplied.

### Reply

On success the tool answers "Demurrage invoice line <invoice reference> booked on record <dnd_id>: <days> day(s) from <start> to <end>, USD <amount>; balance due now USD <balance>." The invoice reference it names is the one customers quote for the line and the one that later waivers and credits against the line point to. The balance shown is what the record owes after the line, in US dollars to two decimals. Should the reply open with "Error:", there is no record under that reference and no line was written.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: What date does the demurrage entry itself carry?**
The day on which it is booked. The period it charges for is shown by its first and last demurrage day.

**Q: Where can a later waiver or credit find this line?**
Through the invoice reference named in the booking reply.
